title: Adesoa a Ɛwɔ Akyɛde a Wɔapow So
intro: Wɔ adesamma abakɔsɛm mfiase, bere a na asase da so ara yɛ abofra na wiase no kura ne home a edi kan no, ɔkra bi gyinaa Ɔbɔadeɛ no anim de ahobrɛase afɔrebɔ. Wɔkarii saa afɔrebɔ no wɔ ɔsoro gye a wogye tom no kari pɛ mu — na wohui sɛ ɛho nhia. Nea edii akyi bae no nyɛ bɔne fafiri ho asɛm, na mmom koma a ahoɔyaw ahyɛ no ma, a ɛde kɔ adeyɛ a wontumi nsakra a ɛbɛka bere nyinaa mu. Eyi yɛ obi a ne din bɛyɛɛ nea ɛne ntɛnkyea a emu yɛ den a edi kan a wɔyɛe pɛn no ho asɛm.
clues: Mebaa ase sɛ mmofra a wodi kan koraa a wɔwoo wɔn pɛn no mu biako, a ɔwofo bi a wunim n’asɛm yiye na ɔwoo wɔn.
Bere bi mebɔɔ ​​afɔre maa Allah, nanso wɔannye antom amfi me hɔ — ɛwom sɛ wɔde adom gyee me nua afɔrebɔ no.
Ahoɔyaw ne abufuw gyee ntini wɔ me koma mu, na mihunahunaa me sɛ mɛma m’ankasa m’abusuafo nkwa aba awiei.
Me nua no bɔɔ me kɔkɔ sɛ mensuro Allah, nanso m’ahantan no amma mantie.
Wɔ mmerɛwyɛ a ɛyɛ hu bere tiaa bi mu no, meyɛɛ adeyɛ bi a wontumi nka ho asɛm wɔ m’ankasa me nuabarima so.
Ɛno akyi no, na minnim mpo sɛnea mede nea mayɛ besie — kosii sɛ wɔsomaa asase so abɔde bi sɛ ɔmmɛkyerɛkyerɛ me.

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
